facts.fact: At a 13 August 2024 working session with a Congolese delegation, Ivory Coast's public procurement directorate (DGMP) presented SIGOMAP, a dematerialised procurement system with separate spaces for economic operators and the administration, and a call centre supporting its use, as the product of work since 2002.
